$schema_comment: Preset catalog seed manifest. Each preset becomes a products row + active product_versions v1 + uploaded preset-media assets linked via product_assets. Image files live under scripts/preset-media/<slug>/ (gitignored) or are https URLs. Seed with: node scripts/seed-catalog-presets.mjs

presets.name: Studio Standard
presets.short_description: A clean, polished studio portrait with soft professional lighting.
presets.long_description: Transform any photo into a polished studio portrait. Even, flattering key light, a tidy seamless backdrop, and a crisp editorial finish make this the reliable everyday portrait look.
presets.instruction_template:
EDIT THE PROVIDED SOURCE IMAGE.

Keep the subject's identity, pose, expression, and outfit exactly as they are. Do not change who the person is, what they are wearing, or how they are positioned.

Re-light and re-stage the photo as a professional studio portrait: a soft, even key light that flatters the face, gentle shadow fill, and a clean seamless neutral-gray studio backdrop behind the subject. Subtly smooth skin texture without altering features. Keep edges natural — no cutout look.

Deliver a crisp, color-accurate editorial studio portrait. Do not add text, logos, or props.

presets.short_description: A confident executive portrait with refined editorial lighting.
presets.long_description: A boardroom-ready editorial portrait. Low-key directional light, a dark atmospheric backdrop, and a composed, confident finish — the portrait look of a founder profile in a business magazine.
presets.instruction_template:

Re-stage the photo as an executive editorial portrait: low-key directional lighting with gentle falloff, a dark desaturated backdrop with subtle depth, restrained contrast, and a composed premium finish. Keep skin tones natural and features untouched. Do not add text, logos, or props.

presets.long_description: A profile worthy of a magazine feature. Sculpted light, filmic grain, and a muted editorial palette give the portrait quiet drama while keeping the subject unmistakably themselves.
presets.instruction_template:

presets.name: Ink Portrait
presets.short_description: A hand-inked illustration that turns your photo into a painted ink portrait.
presets.long_description: An illustrated portrait rendered in confident ink linework with watercolor-wash accents — like a sketchbook illustration of the subject, keeping their likeness, pose, and expression intact.
presets.instruction_template:
EDIT THE PROVIDED SOURCE IMAGE.

Transform the subject into a hand-inked illustration while keeping them unmistakably recognizable — same pose, expression, hairstyle, and outfit silhouette. Render the person in confident black ink linework with loose watercolor-wash accents and sketchbook texture, as if drawn on toned paper. The background becomes a minimal wash, not a photograph.

Keep the likeness honest: do not change facial structure, age, or expression. No text, logos, or props.

presets.long_description: A film-still transformation — anamorphic light, a teal-and-amber grade, and widescreen drama that makes an everyday portrait feel pulled from a movie frame.
